experiment_data.hypothesis: Predictive intervention at α=0.75 boundary regime: Tests if canary-based intervention (switch to α=0.0 when token_entropy drops >15%) can prevent collapse in the transitional regime. At α=0.75, Granger causality becomes FDR-significant (3/8 pairs). If predictive intervention triggers and recovers quality, it validates canary as actionable early warning even in moderate contamination.
